name: security-aws-secretsmanager-resource-policy-review
intent: Secrets Manager resource-policy and version access across principals
artifacts: Secret resource policy, identity policy, KMS dependency, version labels and replication settings.
trace: Evaluate the actual principal and resource/condition context, then distinguish metadata read, secret-value read and changing a version/staging label.
experiment: Use a secret containing only an owned synthetic marker; compare the intended role with another owned role and inspect the exact requested version.
disproof: List/describe permission is not GetSecretValue authority, and a KMS denial must not be attributed to a different resource policy.
repair: Narrow effective value/version authority and retest allowed retrieval, restricted principals and version lifecycle.
branch_decisions: Resolve the requested secret ARN and VersionId/VersionStage, including which versions a policy actually permits. Cross-account access can require both secret and customer-managed KMS-key authority. A readable policy or a GetSecretValue denial caused by KMS does not prove another actor can retrieve plaintext; preserve the blocked edge and inspect rotation identities separately.
